resources.string: Roblox · test-only file editor
Not an FPS unlocker. This path is unverified and the target flag is not on Roblox’s published local-flag allowlist. Roblox may ignore it. No FPS gain or account safety is guaranteed.
Experimental FPS target (not measured FPS)
File state unknown. Root or authorised Shizuku is required; refresh to read.
File is absent. Apply will create it.
The file is not an unambiguous UTF-8 JSON object. Apply is blocked; nothing is replaced.
No numeric FPS target in the file.
File target: %1$d (not measured FPS)
Roblox is not installed. Apply and Close are disabled; recovery remains available.
The file changed outside this editor. Apply and Restore are blocked to avoid overwriting someone else’s changes. Refresh to check again.
Recovery and restart
Before the first write, the original bytes or confirmed absence are saved locally. Unrelated JSON keys are preserved. Keep CatSmoker’s app data until recovery is complete.
The original recovery record is retained across applies and restores. Restore is disabled when already at the original state.
Apply does not close Roblox. Close it separately, then use Launch game above to reopen it.
CLOSE ROBLOX
Write experimental file?
This only writes and verifies the file. Roblox may ignore it; it does not prove an FPS increase. The original state is backed up first. Roblox will not be closed.

Replace the experimental file with the original bytes and permissions, or remove it if it was originally absent? Unsaved target changes will be discarded. The original recovery record is kept. Roblox will not be closed.
Force-stop Roblox now? Your current game session will end and unsaved progress may be lost. This does not change the file.
Continue
File written and verified. Whether Roblox uses it is unverified.
Original file state restored and verified.
Close command completed. Reopen Roblox with Launch game.
Root or authorised Shizuku is required. Grant access in Permissions, then refresh.
Cannot safely read this file. Only a readable regular file up to 16 KiB with no extra links is accepted. Refresh after resolving the file issue.
Recovery record could not be read or saved. No further write is allowed. Keep CatSmoker’s app data and resolve the storage issue before retrying.
File access or command failed. A write may be incomplete. The recovery record is retained; refresh before retrying.
Read-back did not match the requested file. Recovery is retained; refresh to inspect the current state before retrying.
